newsitem.title: CANADA: Court rejects challenge to Hollinger.
newsitem.headline: Court rejects challenge to Hollinger.

text.p: Canada's Federal Court of Appeal rejected a bid to stop Hollinger Inc's takeover of Southam Inc, said the group that launched the bid.
The Council of Canadians, a public interest lobby group, said its bid for a judicial review of the takeover was rejected, in a decision that ended legal challenges to the merger.
The decision also awarded legal costs to Hollinger, the group said in a statement.
In December, the court ruled against the group's bid to seek legal review of the merger, but the group then asked for the judicial review.
The group argued that the concentration of newspaper ownership stemming from the merger would limit the diversity of expression in Canada.
The takeover gave Hollinger control of 54 of Canada's 105 English-language daily newspapers. The newspapers have 43 per cent of circulation.
